title: Masked Autoregressive Flow for Density Estimation
abstract: Introduces masked autoregressive flows, a stackable normalizing-flow density estimator with exact sampling and density evaluation that generalizes Real NVP.

title: Neural Spline Flows
abstract: Develops monotonic rational-quadratic spline transforms that make coupling and autoregressive normalizing flows more flexible while retaining analytic invertibility.

title: Sequential Neural Likelihood: Fast Likelihood-free Inference with Autoregressive Flows
abstract: Presents sequential neural likelihood estimation, which trains autoregressive flows on adaptively simulated data near high posterior density to reduce simulator calls.

title: Automatic Posterior Transformation for Likelihood-Free Inference
abstract: Introduces automatic posterior transformation, a sequential neural posterior estimator that supports dynamically updated proposals without restrictive proposal families or importance weighting.

title: Likelihood-free MCMC with Amortized Approximate Ratio Estimators
abstract: Learns an amortized likelihood-to-evidence ratio from simulations and embeds the estimator in MCMC to sample from posteriors with intractable likelihoods.

title: SBI -- A toolkit for simulation-based inference
abstract: Describes the sbi PyTorch toolkit, which provides a unified interface to neural posterior, likelihood, and ratio estimation methods for black-box simulators.

title: The frontier of simulation-based inference
abstract: Reviews simulation-based inference for complex scientific simulators and surveys the methodological developments expanding its use for inverse problems.

title: BayesFlow: Amortized Bayesian Workflows With Neural Networks
abstract: Introduces the BayesFlow library for simulation-based training of neural networks that perform amortized data compression and Bayesian inference across repeated applications.

title: Unifying Summary Statistic Selection for Approximate Bayesian Computation
abstract: Shows that minimizing expected posterior entropy provides a common principle for learning informative low-dimensional summaries in likelihood-free inference.

title: Neural Importance Sampling for Rapid and Reliable Gravitational-Wave Inference
abstract: Combines amortized neural posterior estimation with likelihood-based importance sampling to correct gravitational-wave posteriors, diagnose failures, and estimate evidence.

title: Truncated proposals for scalable and hassle-free simulation-based inference
abstract: Presents truncated sequential neural posterior estimation, using truncated proposals to simplify sequential SBI optimization and enable scalable coverage tests.

title: Simulation-based Inference for High-dimensional Data using Surjective Sequential Neural Likelihood Estimation
abstract: Introduces a dimensionality-reducing surjective normalizing flow that acts as a learned surrogate likelihood for high-dimensional or manifold-valued simulator data.

title: Real-time gravitational-wave science with neural posterior estimation
abstract: Demonstrates DINGO, a neural posterior estimator trained on simulated detector data that produces calibrated gravitational-wave parameter posteriors in near real time.

title: Calibrating Neural Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Coverage Probability
abstract: Adds a differentiable coverage-calibration term to amortized neural SBI training so posterior uncertainty can be optimized directly for reliable coverage.

title: Variational Inference with Coverage Guarantees in Simulation-Based Inference
abstract: Introduces conformalized amortized neural variational inference, which wraps candidate amortized posteriors with prediction regions having guaranteed marginal coverage.

title: Investigating the Impact of Model Misspecification in Neural Simulation-based Inference
abstract: Studies neural SBI when the simulator and data-generating process differ, documenting severe failure modes and evaluating mitigation strategies under misspecification.

title: Amortized In-Context Bayesian Posterior Estimation
abstract: Compares transformer and permutation-invariant amortized posterior estimators that infer from context sets, including transfer and out-of-distribution evaluations.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
abstract: Develops denoising diffusion probabilistic models and connects their variational training objective with denoising score matching for high-quality sample generation.

title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
abstract: Constructs a non-Markovian diffusion process with the DDPM training objective and a faster deterministic sampling procedure for diffusion models.

title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
abstract: Unifies score-based and diffusion generative models through forward and reverse-time SDEs, enabling predictor-corrector sampling and flexible score-based generation.

title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
abstract: Shows that improved diffusion architectures and classifier guidance can exceed GAN image-synthesis quality while retaining broad distribution coverage.

title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
abstract: Separates diffusion design choices and proposes improved preconditioning, training, and sampling components that increase quality and efficiency.

title: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
abstract: Introduces classifier-free guidance by combining conditional and unconditional score estimates from one jointly trained diffusion model.

title: Compositional Visual Generation with Composable Diffusion Models
abstract: Composes diffusion models as energy-based components so test-time combinations of concepts and relations can generate scenes beyond the combinations seen during training.

title: Universal Guidance for Diffusion Models
abstract: Presents a guidance algorithm that conditions pretrained diffusion models with arbitrary differentiable guidance signals without retraining task-specific components.

title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems
abstract: Extends diffusion posterior sampling to noisy linear and nonlinear inverse problems by approximating posterior updates along the diffusion trajectory.

title: Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models
abstract: Uses a pretrained denoising diffusion model as an unsupervised posterior sampler for a range of linear image-restoration inverse problems.

title: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models
abstract: Adds first-principles residual losses to diffusion training so generated samples satisfy governing physical equations and constrained scientific objectives.

title: Diffusion model approach to simulating electron-proton scattering events
abstract: Applies diffusion models to generate electron-proton scattering events and evaluates momentum distributions, correlations, sum rules, and kinematic observables.

title: GenCast: Diffusion-based ensemble forecasting for medium-range weather
abstract: Introduces a diffusion-based probabilistic weather model that generates global ensembles of medium-range forecasts from decades of reanalysis data.

title: On conditional diffusion models for PDE simulations
abstract: Compares conditional and post-training-conditioned score diffusion models for PDE forecasting and sparse-observation data assimilation, including a hybrid conditioning strategy.

title: Score-based Data Assimilation
abstract: Learns a score-based generative model over dynamical-system trajectories and uses observation guidance only at inference for zero-shot data-assimilation scenarios.

title: Equivariant Diffusion for Molecule Generation in 3D
abstract: Introduces an E(3)-equivariant diffusion model that jointly denoises molecular coordinates and atom types while supporting likelihood computation.

title: MDM: Molecular Diffusion Model for 3D Molecule Generation
abstract: Uses dual equivariant encoders for interatomic forces and controlled diffusion exploration to improve diverse 3D molecular geometry generation.
